title: Ratsputen's Crown of Icy Goodness

html:
Ratsputen's Crown of Icy Goodness
Piece:  Helm
Class:  Mage
Defense Rating:  varies with item level

Ratsputen's Crown of Icy Goodness is a mage helm rainbow. Yes, the name on the item is Ratsputen.

This rainbow is specific to Ratsputin's lair chest. It is not in the shared mythic pool every boss rolls. The Wishing Well can also spit it out once you are high enough for Ratsputin's Gulag. The full list is on Boss Lair Rainbows.

This item is soulbound.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Endurance
  • + Intellect
  • + Divine Damage Resistance
  • + Ice Damage Resistance
  • + Total Health
  • + Total Mana
  • + Ice Damage
  • + Shadow Damage
  • + % Casting Speed
  • + % Movement Speed

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
